faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: Orders are dispatched within 1–2 working days and typically arrive within 3–5 working days depending on your city.

faqs.question: Do you offer Cash on Delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes. Cash on Delivery (COD) is available nationwide on every order, so you only pay when your fragrance arrives.

faqs.question: Where do you deliver?
faqs.answer: We deliver across all major cities and towns in Pakistan for a flat rate of PKR 300.

faqs.question: What size bottles do you offer?
faqs.answer: Every Khan Scents fragrance comes in a 50 mL / 1.7 FL. OZ. bottle, designed for everyday carry and long-term use.

faqs.question: Are your perfumes original or inspired fragrances?
faqs.answer: Our fragrances are luxury-inspired compositions, carefully developed to capture the character of iconic scents at a fraction of the price.

faqs.question: Can I return or exchange my perfume?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer exchanges for damaged or incorrect products. Please contact us within 48 hours of delivery with your order details.

faqs.question: How should I store my perfume?
faqs.answer: Keep your bottle away from direct sunlight and extreme heat. Store it upright in a cool, dry place to preserve the fragrance.

faqs.question: How can I contact you?
faqs.answer: Reach us anytime on WhatsApp or by email — our team typically responds within a few hours.
